review.rationale: The footnote correctly distinguishes a reported reverent substitution from preserved manuscript letters. Rationales separate morphology, preservation, tradition and context without establishing earliest wording. Hebrew, main English, unrelated decisions and historical draft/revision records remain unchanged; exact former cross_check is archived and live review reset.

application.mechanism: Separate apply_patch after editorial approval; no new executor or historical receipt changes.

actual_export_differences.before: Or, following an alternative reading preserved in some traditions: “You do not die.” The Hebrew Masoretic Text reads “We will not die.”
actual_export_differences.after: Hebrew: “We will not die.” An alternative, “You do not die,” comes from a tradition of scribal correction that treats the received wording as a reverent substitution. The manuscript passages checked for this note do not preserve the letter distinguishing the two readings.
